//: Editor-only settings. These silence false-positive 'errors' VS Code shows that are NOT real build errors — `npm run test`, `tsc --noEmit`, and `next build` are the source of truth.
// tailwind css: Tailwind v4 uses at-rules like @theme, @apply, @custom-variant that VS Code's built-in CSS validator doesn't recognize and flags as 'Unknown at rule'. Disable the built-in CSS/PostCSS linters; the Tailwind IntelliSense extension (recommended below) understands them.
// next generated types: Next.js writes generated route types under .next/. If the dev server is force-killed mid-write, a half-written file there can briefly show phantom TypeScript errors across every route. Exclude .next from the editor's file watcher and search so it isn't surfaced; a clean `next dev`/`next build` always regenerates it correctly.
